frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc the image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

discThickness.basis: The stellar disc's exponential scale height as its scale length over 7.3, the mean flattening Kregel et al. (2002) measured for edge-on discs, with Leroy et al.'s (2021) stellar scale length, 2.1 kpc at their 9.96 Mpc (43.5″): 287 pc. For young objects it is an upper value. Each row's own height is drawn, not measured.

meaning: Planetary nebulae of M95 that Scheuermann et al. (2022) found in the PHANGS-MUSE [O III] maps: one dot per nebula at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the planetary-nebula color M31's and M33's dots share. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
